# 🧰 Engineering Templates

Use these templates to make project decisions and changes reviewable. Replace every placeholder with accurate, project-specific details. Do not fabricate approvals, test results, risk acceptance, or audit findings.

- [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md)
- [Feature Specification](feature-spec.md)
- [Bug Report](bug-report.md)
- [Test Plan and Report](test-plan-report.md)
- [Accessibility Review](accessibility-review.md)
- [Security Review](security-review.md)
- [Release Checklist](release-checklist.md)
